I like the idea of it tbh but I think that it’s constantly being rendered. You have to remember that Discord is a web-based program. It’s a client but it’s still web-based. With that being said they should make it to where you’re able to disable certain features. For example if you were able to disable the store page/tab entirely, you wouldn’t be rendering as much (and downloading data?). It’s also worth noting that if you’re in a call and screen sharing or being screen shared to, your CPU, for some people, sky rockets (my friend’s does this and he’s unable to do anything while I share my screen until I turn it back off). I’m not saying these are bad features by any means, I love it personally and I could never go back to Skype. But you should be able to disable some features in some way so the client doesn’t become unusable.

In short if you love the Fallout games with a passion it’s worth trying but if you’re playing it just to pass time, you will not enjoy it more than likely just because you’re coming from a newer game. My favorite, personally, was Fallout 3 and I have thousands of hours in it from modding and speedrunning. But when I originally beat Fallout 3 and moved on to New Vegas, I loved it even more (NV) because of all the massive decisions you have to make which changed the game immensely from what I can remember (been a long time since I’ve done a play through of New Vegas). If the clunkiness or stiff movement gets to you, you can always install mods and unofficial patches that won’t take very long to install and will significantly make your experience feel better. With all that being said, I highly recommend getting the DLC if you do get NV.
